project_name.justification: The text announces an option agreement on the "Silverknife Property" between CMC Metals Ltd. and Coeur Mining, Inc.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as Coeur Silvertip Holdings, Ltd., a subsidiary of Coeur Mining, Inc. The text states: "...entered into an option agreement (“Agreement”) with Coeur Silvertip Holdings, Ltd. (“Coeur”), a subsidiary of Coeur Mining, Inc. (NYSE: CDE)..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Coeur Mining, Inc., is not mentioned in the text. Aoife McGrath is mentioned as Senior Vice President of Exploration for Coeur.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The Agreement provides Coeur with the ability to earn a 75% interest in the Property...

primary_commodity.justification: The project is located in the 'Rancheria Silver District' and the text states: "Exploration at Silverknife is targeting high-grade silver-lead-zinc CRDs..."

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source documents.

currency.justification: The text specifies Canadian dollars for the financial commitments: "...$500,000 Cdn is cash payments to CMC and $3,550,000 Cdn is exploration expenditures."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The agreement includes total cash payments of $500,000 to earn the interest, as stated: "...of which $500,000 Cdn is cash payments to CMC..." and confirmed in the cumulative total of the payments table.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms consist of cash payments and exploration expenditures, with no mention of payments in shares.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and exploration expenditure components of the deal are explicitly separated, so a combined value is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The agreement does not involve the issuance of shares as consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: There is no mention of share warrants in the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: The term "Option Payments" used in the document's table refers to the cash consideration, which is captured in the `cash_payments_raw` field. There are no separate stock option payments.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares are being issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is defined by a monetary value, not a number of meters to be drilled.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement requires Coeur to fund exploration expenditures totaling $3,550,000 to earn its interest: "...and $3,550,000 Cdn is exploration expenditures."

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement notes that the seller, CMC, has a right related to an NSR: "CMC retained its right to purchase an existing 1% NSR on the Property."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text does not specify the size of the Silverknife Property in hectares or any other unit of area.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text does not specify the size of the Silverknife Property.

resource_size.justification: The text provides details of drill intersections but does not contain a quantified mineral resource estimate with total tonnage or ounces for the property.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified in the text with its ticker and exchange: "Coeur Mining, Inc. (NYSE: CDE)".
